name: How long does it typically take to construct an integrated pool and spa?
description: Construction for an integrated pool and spa typically takes 8 to 16 weeks, depending on design and site specifics.

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to construct an integrated pool and spa?

acceptedAnswer.text: The construction timeline for an integrated pool and spa varies depending on design complexity, site conditions, permitting, and weather. Generally, projects can take anywhere from 8 to 16 weeks from excavation to completion. This includes phases such as design finalization, permitting, excavation, shell construction, plumbing and electrical installation, decking, landscaping, and final water balancing. We provide a detailed project schedule after the design phase is complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: Construction for an integrated pool and spa typically takes 8 to 16 weeks, depending on design and site specifics.
